lines.en: I can't really walk, truth be told.
There are four wheels under my base.
I get pushed half a tile along.
I squeak as I slide across.
I settle back to the centre of my spot.
Two faint tracks remain on the floor.
My wheels spin on the tiles.
I'm turned to face the front doors.
I keep smiling as I'm moved.
I slide along a straight line.
Slow, but at least I moved.
I roll over to the next display.
One of my anchor latches loosened.
I wobble twice after stopping.
The floor warms where I scrape.
My walrus tusks are always showing.
I hold my welcoming pose.
I won't move for the whole day.
A faint hum comes from my shell.
My sailor cap sits low.

lines.zh: 我的胡须是用塑料做的。
lines.en: My whiskers are made of plastic.
My eyes stay fixed ahead.
The blue-grey fur looks worn.
It's fine that I don't move.
I smile the same when someone passes.
The counter light shines on my head.
I'm waiting for closing time.
My flipper-hands are raised mid-air.

lines.zh: 展示牌的影子落在我身上。
lines.en: The sign's shadow falls over me.
My base sits flush with the floor.
Standing still is tiring enough.
You look up at this whole getup.

lines.zh: 我的獠牙比你的手还长。
lines.en: My tusks are longer than your hand.
I'm only standing here, that's all.
Come closer if you want a good look.
I'm not much of a talker, honestly.
Your hat looks a lot like mine.
Do you think I'm convincing?
Don't stand in my shadow — it's cold.
The front doors are behind you.
I cut a respectable figure.
You look a little disappointed.

lines.zh: 我的外壳被敲掉一块漆。
lines.en: A patch of paint got knocked off.
That made me sway twice.
I can't even manage a grunt.
Something jolted under my base.
My smile is exactly as it was.
Something buzzes inside my body.
My flipper went slightly crooked.
My pose hasn't sagged at all.
You hit that quite hard.
I don't intend to fall over.
Even if you gave it, I can't hold it.
Walruses don't eat such things.
Put it down by my feet.
I'll just keep smiling like this.
Stand there holding it, then.
I can't smell it or taste it.

lines.zh: 这算是给展品的礼物吗。
lines.en: Is this a gift for a display piece?
It would look better on the counter.
Don't push it into my mouth.
I don't need any of that, thank you.
I'm quite content as I am.
Keep it, truly.
My tusks are plastic.
My head simply won't turn.
That's a kindness wasted.
Hit me — I won't even sway.
My base is bolted down tight.
I smile without shifting an inch.
That won't budge me at all.
You step back two paces and look.
You ought to walk around me.
I'm blocking half the aisle.
Even my sailor cap didn't tilt.
Does your hand hurt at all?
Remember to step aside next time.

lines.zh: 我一年都不会抬一次手。
lines.en: I don't lift a hand once a year.
I'm set out for the guests to see.
That has nothing to do with me.
My pose is locked in place.
The display's too narrow for two.
Your tusks are shorter than mine.
Let's just stand side by side.
I can't even blink.
Look — neither of us is moving.
I'd call that getting along well.
I can't reach out to pick it up.
It rolled up beside my base.
This thing landed by my feet.
I saw it, but I can't move.
It's wedged under my flipper.
A coin, and no one came for it.
It caught against a floor tile.
I'll wait for a guest to claim it.
There it lies, and stays lying.
Won't somebody pick it up?
I can't even turn my head.
Someone has undone the latches.
The floor has started to creak.
This isn't business hours.
The front doors are locked now.
The lights go out one by one.
Footsteps behind the counter.
You'll hear the wheels.
Let's both wait a moment.
I slide very slowly, that's all.
My wheels grind on the floor.
You've run into the display area.
This face keeps on smiling.
I'm getting closer to you too.

lines.zh: 你听得见我过来的声音。
lines.en: You can hear me coming.
The tiles clank under my wheels.
No need to hurry; I'm smiling.
Your way out is over here.
Now it is my turn.
I face forward and can't turn.
My flipper slams into you.
You're shoved into a display stand.
A dull clang comes from inside me.
My base is planted on the floor.
You back off; I slide after you.

lines.zh: 我把鳍摆回原来的角度。
lines.en: I set my flippers back to their angle.
You rolled half a turn on the floor.
Don't walk any further forward.
I've been set onto my display spot.
The walrus look came out well.

lines.zh: 灯正好打在我的帽子上。
lines.en: The light falls right on my cap.
There are no guests in the hall yet.
I raise a flipper-hand.

lines.zh: 灰蓝色的毛在灯下发亮。
lines.en: My blue-grey fur shines under the lamp.
Someone is peering in at the door.
And so I stand right here.
This whole day will be long.
I'll stand here all day again.

lines.zh: 我的毛被烤得卷起来了。
lines.en: The fire curled my fur.

lines.zh: 砸下来的时候底座裂了。
lines.en: The base cracked when it came down.
Water soaked me right through.
The blast flipped me right over.

lines.zh: 弹丸在我的胸口留了个坑。
lines.en: A shot left a pit in my chest.

lines.zh: 那一阵光让我的灯灭了。
lines.en: That flash put my lights out.
I'm manufactured; I don't get hungry.

lines.zh: 电流把我的毛都立起来了。
lines.en: The current stood my fur on end.

lines.zh: 我从底座上被扯下去了。
lines.en: I've been torn off my base.
